videos.desc: An outdoor garden ceremony. A blonde bride in a white dress and veil, tears on her cheeks, slides a ring onto the finger of a groom in a black suit while he laughs with joy. They kiss under a tall flower arch. Confetti falls as they turn hand in hand and walk back down the aisle between rows of clapping guests, past flower arrangements and lavender, and at the end the whole wedding party throws their arms in the air and cheers.

A white-haired woman in a flowered apron and oven gloves lifts a hot tray of chocolate-chip cookies out of the oven in a wooden cabin kitchen while a small girl behind her presses her hands together and gasps. Two girls crowd in beside her and she hands each of them a cookie from the tray. She then sits in a wing armchair with a picture book open on her lap, one girl asleep against her shoulder and the other leaning in wide-eyed as she turns the pages. In the last shot she sits at the head of a long garden table with the girls and other adults, all clinking teacups over a plate of the cookies.
videos.said: - You can't even look in there.

videos.desc: A young woman standing in a crowd stares upward and points one finger at the sky; the people beside her raise their arms and point at the same spot; the camera pulls back over an old city square where hundreds of people all point straight up together.

A young woman films herself in a packed street party at sunset, laughing into the camera with people pressed all around her. She climbs a green lamppost and pulls herself up above the crowd while people below film her on their phones. A wide shot shows the whole street filled with thousands of people facing the low sun. She grins into the lens, then stands raised above the crowd with her arms up while everyone below cheers with their hands in the air and confetti falls through the golden light.

A red-haired boy grins as he slides down a blue playground slide on a sunny day. He then runs across the grass of a park lawn and kicks a black-and-white football, and walks back with the climbing frame behind him. The camera pans over an empty park path and ends on the playground with the ball lying on the lawn.

On a Paris cafe terrace two women in coats hug at a table set with coffee cups. Then an elderly grey-haired couple sits on a green bench by the street; the man cups the woman's cheek and they kiss for a long moment. Finally a young couple kisses in front of the Eiffel Tower, the man dipping the woman backwards while guests at the cafe tables clap.

An outdoor tea party on a lawn in front of parkland. A young woman in a long pale floral Regency dress and a straw bonnet, her hair in ringlets, stands at a laid table, then sits and pours tea from a white porcelain teapot into painted cups. She passes a plate of scones with jam across the table to a man in a jacket who wipes his hands on a linen napkin, and at the end she raises her teacup with the others and smiles into the camera.

A red-haired woman in an apron is shown through a day with her children. She lifts a laughing toddler in a pink shirt up into the air in the living room, then flips pancakes at the stove while two small girls reach up for them, then kneels on the carpet and holds a girl's leg to look at a grazed knee. At the end she hugs the children goodbye on the pavement outside a school, among other parents and children with backpacks.

A young woman in a grey t-shirt and black work gloves carries a large cardboard box down a driveway towards an open removal truck on a sunny suburban street. She walks back up the ramp, and two other people join her: one man inside the truck and one on the ground help her push a brown leather sofa in beside the stacked boxes. She then lifts another box up into the truck and finally turns to the camera, grinning and out of breath.

Four short scenes of a mother and a father looking after their children. The mother spoons food from a bowl into a baby's mouth in a high chair while the father steadies the chair. Both of them kneel on a rug and help two toddlers stack a tall tower of coloured wooden blocks. At night the mother leans over a bed and tucks a boy under a blue duvet, and the father sits beside the next bed reading a picture book to a girl. Finally children run and swing in a sunny playground while the adults stand and watch.

A low shot follows the legs of men and women in dark suits carrying shopping bags as they stride across a wide striped crossing. The camera then moves into a covered market arcade so full that shoulders and backpacks touch: shoppers in coats and school blazers press slowly past stalls hung with food and signs. Finally the view rises above a huge city junction, where hundreds of walkers pour off every kerb at once and fill the whole crossing from both directions under tall buildings and video screens, until the road cannot be seen for the moving mass of them.

In a sunny green park, an old man with white hair, a flat cap and a beige suit strides and bounces along the path with his arms swinging, laughing at the camera. A grey-haired man in a cycling jersey pedals a bicycle along the same tree-lined path. Then a group of about ten white-haired women and men in summer dresses and light clothes stand spread out on a paved square doing a dance-exercise class together, arms stretched out to the side, all moving in time under the trees.

In a green park an old man in a flat cap and tweed jacket dances along a path with his fists up, beaming. An old woman with white hair in a lilac cardigan leans down over a bed of bright orange marigolds and looks at them closely while a cyclist rides past behind her. Then several elderly couples dance together on a wide paved terrace under a blue sky with white clouds: one white-haired man holds his wife by the hand and waist and turns her, and the pair in the foreground hold each other by the shoulders, laughing into each other's faces as they dance.

A boy stands with his father at the open bonnet of a car in a bright garage; the father hands him a spanner and both grin. The same boy is then hugged tight by his mother in a white kitchen, kicks a football back and forth with his father on the driveway, and finally plays with other children on a park lawn while the parents watch.

Handheld phone footage at a sunny skatepark and the adjoining basketball court. A boy in a dark hooded sweatshirt rides a skateboard across the concrete and steps off; another boy stands watching him from the far side of the bowl while more boys wait on the grass. Three boys shoot a basketball at an outdoor hoop. Then about ten teenage boys in hoodies and caps press into a tight ring around one phone, pointing at the screen, shouting and laughing, a backpack lying on the grass at their feet.

A family barbecue in a green backyard. A big bearded man in sunglasses and a bright Hawaiian shirt runs a small boy around the lawn in a wheelbarrow while the boy throws his arms up and shouts. At the grill another man in a blue T-shirt turns the meat; two little girls stand in front of the smoke holding handfuls of marshmallows and grin at the camera. The bearded man then sits down at the picnic table and arm-wrestles one of the girls, letting her push his hand down while she laughs, and the clip ends wide on the whole family carrying children on their shoulders around the smoking grill and the loaded picnic table.

A sunny open-air street market lined with fruit and vegetable stalls and tall old apartment blocks. A young woman in a red summer dress spins round on the pavement, hair flying, laughing. A second woman in a neon-yellow sports top and black leggings jogs towards the camera down the same street. An elderly white-haired woman leans out of a first-floor window onto a balcony packed with red geraniums, watering can in hand, smiling down. Back at street level the woman in red meets a woman in a navy business suit carrying a briefcase; they talk face to face beside a stall of tomatoes, then stand together with shopping bags while the woman in red waves at the camera.

A stone terrace on a Greek-style island at sunset, with whitewashed walls, blue shutters, red geraniums, pink bougainvillea and a string of light bulbs above the sea. A very old man with white hair and a white moustache, in a striped shirt, sits on a blue wooden chair and blows out the candles on a white cake. A laughing young woman with curly hair, in a blue top and white skirt, holds the cake out to him, then leans down and kisses the top of his head while he smiles.

On a harbour quay at dusk under dark storm clouds, a young woman with long dark curly hair and a navy wool coat over an orange high-visibility vest sits by a rusty bollard. She cups her hands around a burning match and lights a thin white cigarette held between her lips, shakes out the match, breathes out smoke and then holds the cigarette in her fingers while she pushes her hair back. Behind her a lit ferry is being unloaded by workers in hi-vis jackets.

At a rainy outdoor rock concert at night, a young man with a tall black mohawk and a studded leather jacket, with a baby in a grey carrier strapped to his chest, kneels in the mud beside a laughing young woman who holds a black umbrella and rests a hand on her rounded belly. He holds a pair of tiny white baby shoes up to her belly, his mouth wide open with joy. Two men in denim vests watch, one with a hand on his chest. A huge crowd faces a stage with bright lights and bursts of flame.

In a busy family kitchen on a warm evening, seen through an open doorway, a laughing young woman in a cream cable-knit jumper is greeted by a big golden retriever standing up on its back legs with its paws on her, while another young woman hugs her from the side. A young man rushes over and hugs her too, and they all laugh together. An older man holds up a cake, a second dog stands in front, and bunting hangs over the stove and dresser.

On a sunny day, the view moves from a stone courtyard, where a wedding party gathers by long white tables and string lights, up to a small balcony. There a young man in sunglasses stands shirtless in an overfilled inflatable paddling pool with a pink flamingo ring around his waist, grinning and giving a thumbs up, while water pours over the railing onto the guests below. A bride in a white dress and men in suits look up, some holding white chairs over their heads.

A laughing grandmother in a flowery dress, a cardigan and a sun hat drives an old red tractor with bunting along a dusty farm track beside a golden wheat field in the evening, raising one fist in the air. Next to her, a young bride in a white lace dress and long veil holds on and laughs. Behind them a trailer full of cheering wedding guests in suits and dresses waves hats and jackets in the air, and a small dog runs along in the dust as the tractor comes closer.

A warm hallway on a snowy night. A middle-aged woman in a burgundy cardigan and slippers holds a young man's face and kisses his cheek as he comes in through the open front door in a green parka, laughing. He drops his big canvas bag, they hug tightly and he lifts her a little off the floor, then she kisses his cheek again. A golden retriever jumps up at them, snow falls outside, a wooden sledge and scarves hang on the wall and a kitchen glows at the back.

Inside a home garage in the evening, with the roller door open, a young woman with her hair in a messy bun, a white vest and oil-stained overalls lies on a low wheeled board under an old motorbike. She rolls out from under it, sits up under a work lamp and holds up a small part, smiling. An older man with grey hair and a moustache in a checked shirt leans down into view beside her and looks at the part. Tools hang on a wall board and a black tool chest stands behind.

A family hallway with framed paintings and a wooden floor. A young woman in a yellow jacket, far too big for it, sits squeezed into a small red toy pedal car and rolls towards the viewer, laughing, with a teddy bear on her shoulder. A beagle trots beside her. Behind her a young man takes a toy drum out of an old wooden toy chest and lifts it up over his head, and a wooden rocking horse stands by the wall. Warm light comes through the glass front door.

A bright kitchen with blue patterned tiles, open shelves and a wicker lamp. A young woman in a mustard T-shirt kneels up on a wooden chair and raises one finger high in the air as she starts to list her points, then lowers her hand and points across the table. Across the breakfast table a young man in a white T-shirt holds his face in his hand, laughs and then hides his face. Mugs, bowls and a frying pan with eggs cover the table, and a ginger cat sits on the counter behind him.
